episodes.student_evidence: 在此之前可以写一些断言/脚本来测，但逻辑不要他复杂，现阶段主要工作是开发
episodes.what_happened: A C++17 kernel was written together with three small test scripts (a SQL smoke test, a SIGKILL crash test and a WAL dump). The smoke test caught a real bug: the failure path rolled back the whole undo list, so a failed INSERT also removed the table created by an earlier statement. The crash test caught a second one: the WAL was framed by newlines, and a statement that began with a newline broke its record, so replay silently dropped it.
episodes.result_evidence: ERROR 3 table doesn't exist: table doesn't exist: docs
fixes: undo is applied only from the mark taken before the statement, so earlier statements of the same transaction survive
the WAL uses length prefixed binary records ( 'S' | u32 length | payload, 'C' ) which are immune to newlines and quotes inside the statement
episodes.retest_evidence: run_smoke.sh 的 ERROR 计数为 0 ；crash_test.sh 重启后只剩已提交的 1  keep ，未提交的 2  drop 不出现；COMMIT 后立刻 SIGKILL 时 7  kept 仍在

episodes.student_evidence: 随着赛题测试包公布再进行官方标准测试，在此之前可以写一些断言/脚本来测
episodes.what_happened: The lesson carried over from the first round was that an optimisation is only meaningful when it is measured with the same instrument the score uses. Here that instrument was reconstructed: wall clock, physical bytes from /proc io and later from a private cgroup v2 io.stat, and peak memory from memory.peak (which, unlike RSS, includes the page cache).
episodes.result_evidence: load T=712 ms  B_read=0 KiB  B_write=0 KiB  M_peak=16204 KiB ；query T=163 ms
episodes.migration: The same measurement-first approach was applied to a different question and a different metric set (three graded quantities instead of nine, ranking instead of a capped absolute score).

episodes.student_evidence: 这个题现在的完成度是多少
episodes.what_happened: The completion was assessed item by item against the published requirements rather than by feeling: which of the required capabilities exist, which are unverified (the image build), and which cannot even be started without the unpublished package (the protocol: statement framing, result format, error codes, readiness marker, exact/ann switch).
episodes.result_evidence: 约 55~60% ；官方评测接入 0%（题包没发布，协议层完全未接）
episodes.tradeoff: The protocol layer would otherwise be guessed and then thrown away, so the order was changed: build the parts that cannot be invalidated by the package (storage, transactions, recovery, vector scan) and leave src/protocol/ as the single adapter.

episodes.student_evidence: 我不太懂，为什么json文件还杜撰不了
episodes.what_happened: A file can be written with invented content, so the question is fair. The answer separated what is technically possible from what survives review: the material must agree with the submitted source, the commit history and the results it quotes; the review adds three independent passes, locatable JSON pointers with verbatim quotes and a de-duplication rule; and a fabricated chain would have to invent the failures and corrections that the rubric actually rewards.
episodes.result_evidence: 同一个 128 KiB 文件要支撑五维多个实例、三轮取中位、原文逐字匹配

episodes.student_evidence: 语言就选择c++等最容易高性能的
episodes.what_happened: The query path was optimised in measured steps, each justified by the previous number: 79244 us per TopK query (the vector literal was re-parsed for every row), then 1313 us after parsing it once per statement, 581 us with a bounded heap instead of a full candidate sort, 461 us with the filter compiled to a column index and a literal, 286 us with that predicate inside the scan loop, and finally 145 us with a batched AVX2 kernel plus a float-reject bound.
episodes.result_evidence: query:  T=145 ms for 1000 queries (145 us/query) with B_read=0 KiB
episodes.reflection: The last step stopped improving because each query must still read 5.12 MB of vectors, which at roughly 35 GB/s effective is the memory bandwidth floor of this machine, not a kernel problem.

retrospective: Design decisions that paid off: table private page files with bounded buffer pools (so a data set larger than the memory budget still works, verified with a 16 KiB page cache), a length prefixed WAL with one commit marker per transaction (replay is idempotent), and per statement undo marks.

Design decisions that were corrected by measurement: the failure path first rolled back the whole undo list; the WAL first used newline framing; the page allocator first wrote a zero page that was later written again; the vector literal was first parsed through the SQL tokenizer, one AST node per number.
What is still unverified: the container image has not been built locally (Docker was not running during this work), and the official protocol adapter cannot be written until the package is published.
limitations: No page level crash test that kills the process while recovery is replaying the log: replay is idempotent by construction (insert-if-absent, update-upsert, delete-if-present) but the case has not been exercised.
The vector index is a correctness preserving structure rather than an approximate index: at 10k x 128 float32 the exact scan is both faster and recall 1.0, which the submitted exact mode relies on.
Deleted rows leave dead space inside their page and in the cache until the next checkpoint rewrites the table.
